source_cell: C4 CANDIDATE double kappa=0.505; n = 500000; measured loss fraction 0.00081
injection_definition: honest overflow, plus a further q fraction of the draws the type WOULD have allowed back, removed silently -- conditioning in excess of what the floor forces, which is the defect the battery exists to exclude
note: the largest loss fraction among the UNCAPPED LOADER CELLS (C0-C4), not the global maximum over the scalar ladder. The earlier wording said 'whose loss is not dominated by honest overflow', which is unusable: G1 requires the candidate's avoidable loss to be exactly zero, so every loss it has is honest overflow and that qualifier empties the set. What it was there to exclude is the degenerate scalar configurations -- float kappa = 0.5001 loses 98 per cent of its draws, where detection is trivial and says nothing -- not any cell from among C0-C4.
